title: 第二十一章 洗髓境圆满第二十二章 孟大江隐藏的奇珍
lines: “你啊。”柳夜白摇头一笑，对这位老友他也无话可说了。
不过他们俩能成为生死至交，不就是因为钦佩彼此为人么？
“走，进城。”孟大江说道。
他们俩悄然来到余昉府城，如今是深夜，城门早就关闭，城墙上更有守卫看守。但孟大江、柳夜白却是悄无声息化作两道幻影，轻轻一跃就飞到约莫数十丈高，比城墙都要高上超过十丈！并且他们俩身体周围有淡淡黑雾笼罩，在黑夜中越加难以察觉。
就这么的，他们俩从城墙上方十丈处悄无声息滑翔而过。
“大人。”
“大人。”
城墙上，城门守备王潜樊率领数位手下在城墙上巡视，守卫们也都恭敬的很。
“嗯？”王潜樊忽然皱眉抬头。
“大人，怎么了？”一旁的副手疑惑问道。
“让兄弟们小心点，可别让妖怪给潜进来。”王潜樊皱眉道，他感到有些不太对劲，可又说不出为什么，他可是悟出‘势’的无漏境强者，是余昉府城的守备。神魔之下，不太可能逃出他的感应。若真是神魔、妖王层次的存在……
他们这些凡俗阻拦也没意义。
“是。”副手连应道。
孟大江、柳夜白悄然进入余昉府城。
“刚才那位城门守卫的领头人，竟然是一位悟出势的高手，若是我们大意点，都可能被他发现。”柳夜白笑道，“若是真被发现了，我们就不能在这久留了。”
“是我连累你了。”孟大江说道。
“你我兄弟还说这些？”柳夜白说道。
余昉府城的一座富商宅院，这宅院的仆人们都知道，自家主人来了两位好友，主人无比热情的招待着。
“好了，你退下吧。”柳夜白吩咐。
“是。”富商乖巧的很。
厅内只剩下柳夜白、孟大江二人，只见孟大江正盯着一头烤全羊吃着，旁边还有大量牛肉吃着。
咔嚓咔嚓~~~孟大江牙口很好，再硬的骨头在他嘴里都轻易咬得粉碎吃干净，吃着肉，偶尔还拿起一葫芦喝着里面的酒水。
“大江，看你这么吃，我都馋了。”柳夜白坐在那，拿着酒壶给自己倒酒，悠然喝着，笑道，“说起来，至少在东宁府，你这饭量绝对排第一吧。一头烤全羊，还有上百斤的牛肉猪肉，你就这么吃的干干净净。”
“你在羡慕我？”孟大江明显略微胖了一些，他拿起旁边的酒坛给自己葫芦倒酒，等倒满后，又从怀里拿出一瓷瓶，取出三颗丹丸放进葫芦里融在酒水内。
“不管怎样，你这修行法门我之前是听都没听过。这世间，还有吃就能变强的。”柳夜白感慨道。
孟大江一边喝酒一边吃肉。
将肉食全部吃完后，他胖了约莫十斤。
“我这样疗伤也快，我今天伤势就好了大半。”孟大江说道，“明天就能彻底好了。不过之前一战燃烧了太多血肉，要恢复到巅峰，还得吃上五六天。”
“慢慢吃，不急。”柳夜白笑着，“孟川要踏入脱胎境，最起码要到五月份，时间来得及。”
“嗯。”孟大江点点头。
在这座富商宅院内居住了六天，这六天时间内，都是柳夜白在暗中操持，孟大江每天都会吃喝修炼，六天过后，体重增加了约莫八十斤。从颇为帅气模样又变成了一个胖子。
content_en:
"You." Liu Yebai shook his head and smiled. He had nothing to say to this old friend.
But wasn't it because they admired each other as human beings that they could become life-and-death best friends?
"Let's go into the city." Meng Dajiang said.
The two of them quietly arrived at Yufang Mansion City. It was late at night, the city gates had long been closed, and there were guards guarding the city walls. But Meng Dajiang and Liu Yebai quietly turned into two phantoms, and flew to a height of about tens of feet with a single leap, which was more than ten feet higher than the city wall! Moreover, there was a faint black mist surrounding their bodies, making them even more difficult to detect in the dark night.
Just like that, the two of them silently glided past ten feet above the city wall.
"My lord."
"My lord."
On the city wall, the city gate guard Wang Qianfan led several of his men to patrol the city wall, and the guards were also very respectful.
"Huh?" Wang Qianfan suddenly frowned and raised his head.
"Sir, what's wrong?" the deputy on the side asked in confusion.
"Brothers, be careful and don't let monsters sneak in." Wang Qianfan frowned. He felt something was not right, but he couldn't explain why. He was a strong man in the Wuluo Realm who understood the 'potential' and was the defender of Yu Fang's city. Under the influence of gods and demons, it is impossible to escape his induction. If it really is an existence at the level of gods, demons, and demon kings...
Their ordinary obstructions are meaningless.
"Yes." Deputy Lian responded.
Whoosh~~~
Meng Dajiang and Liu Yebai quietly entered Yufang Fucheng.
"The leader of the city gate guard just now turned out to be a master of understanding the situation. If we are careless, we may be discovered by him." Liu Yebai smiled and said, "If we are really discovered, we can't stay here for a long time."
"I am the one who caused you trouble." Meng Dajiang said.
"You and I brothers are still talking about this?" Liu Yebai said.
…
There is a wealthy businessman's house in Yufang City. The servants of this house all know that their master has two friends here, and the master entertains them with great enthusiasm.
"Okay, please step back." Liu Yebai ordered.
"Yes." The wealthy businessman was very obedient.
Only Liu Yebai and Meng Dajiang were left in the hall. Meng Dajiang was staring at a roasted whole lamb and eating a lot of beef next to it.
Click, click, click~~~ Meng Dajiang has very good teeth. No matter how hard the bone is, he can easily bite it into pieces and eat it clean. He eats the meat, and occasionally picks up a gourd and drinks the wine inside.
"Dajiang, seeing you eating like this makes me greedy." Liu Yebai sat there, pouring wine for himself with a flask, drinking leisurely, and said with a smile, "Speaking of which, at least in Dongning Mansion, you are definitely the biggest eater. A roasted whole lamb, and hundreds of kilograms of beef and pork, you can eat it all like this."
"Are you envious of me?" Meng Dajiang was obviously a little fatter. He picked up the wine jar next to him and poured wine into his gourd. When it was full, he took out a porcelain bottle from his arms, took out three pills, put them into the gourd and mixed them with the wine.
"Anyway, I have never heard of your practice method before. In this world, there are still people who can become stronger by eating." Liu Yebai said with emotion.
Meng Dajiang drank and ate meat at the same time.
After eating all the meat, he gained about ten pounds.
"I heal quickly this way. Most of my injuries are healed today." Meng Dajiang said, "It will be completely healed tomorrow. However, too much flesh and blood was burned in the previous battle. It will take five or six days to recover to the peak."
"Eat slowly, don't be in a hurry." Liu Yebai smiled, "Meng Chuan will enter the realm of rebirth, at least until May, there is still enough time."
"Yeah." Meng Dajiang nodded.
…
After living in this wealthy businessman's mansion for six days, Liu Yebai secretly managed it. Meng Dajiang ate, drank and practiced every day. After six days, he gained about 80 kilograms in weight. From a rather handsome appearance to a fat man.
